segments.en: And well I think we should listen to this dialogue for the last time and then we'll come back and talk a little bit more about Veronica and Steven.
segments.zh: 好吧，我认为我们应该最后一次听这个对话，然后我们会回来多谈谈维罗妮卡和史蒂文。

segments.en: Veronica, wait.
segments.zh: 维罗妮卡，等等。

segments.en: Come on, honey.
segments.zh: 来吧，亲爱的。

segments.en: Get back in the car.
segments.zh: 回到车上。

segments.en: Let's talk it over, okay?
segments.zh: 我们好好谈谈，好吗？

segments.en: No.
segments.zh: 不。

segments.en: I'm tired of your lies.
segments.zh: 我厌倦了你的谎言。

segments.en: I don't know who you are anymore.
segments.zh: 我现在都不知道你到底是谁了。

segments.en: Veronica, it's me, the man that has and always will love you.
segments.zh: 维罗妮卡，是我啊，是那个一直爱你、以后也会永远爱你的人。

segments.en: I'm sorry that I've lied to you, believe me.
segments.zh: 对不起，我一直骗你。请相信我。

segments.en: It's been hard for me as well and time and again I've thought of coming clean.
segments.zh: 这对我来说也很困难，我一次又一次地想过要坦白。

segments.en: But I couldn't put you or my mission at risk.
segments.zh: 可我不能让你或我的任务陷入危险。

segments.en: It's all over now.
segments.zh: 现在一切都结束了。

segments.en: My assignment is complete and now I have to go back to India.
segments.zh: 我的任务完成了，现在我必须回到印度。

segments.en: What?
segments.zh: 什么？

segments.en: Are you kidding?
segments.zh: 你开玩笑吧？

segments.en: Is there anything else I should know before I never see you again?
segments.zh: 在我们永别之前，还有什么事是我该知道的吗？

segments.en: How could you deceive me like that?
segments.zh: 你怎么能这样欺骗我？

segments.en: Yes.
segments.zh: 是的。

segments.en: Veronica, I know that this isn't the best time and you probably hate me right now but I want to be completely forthright with you.
segments.zh: 维罗妮卡，我知道这不是最好的时间，你现在可能讨厌我，但我想对你完全坦率。

segments.en: I know deep in my heart that you are the best thing that has ever happened to me.
segments.zh: 我心里明白，你是我人生中最美好的事。

segments.en: Veronica, will you marry me?
segments.zh: 维罗妮卡，你愿意嫁给我吗？

segments.en: Come with me to India, baby.
segments.zh: 跟我来印度，宝贝。

segments.en: I can't make it for everything that's happened but I can promise you my undying love.
segments.zh: 我无法弥补所发生的一切，但我可以向你保证我永恒的爱。

segments.en: I will be the most devoted husband and I will cherish you always.
segments.zh: 我会做一个尽心尽责的丈夫，永远珍惜你。

segments.en: Stephen, I can't just leave everything at the drop of a hat.
segments.zh: 斯蒂芬，我没法说走就走，抛开一切。

segments.en: With everything that has happened between us, I just don't know you anymore.
segments.zh: 发生了这么多事，我觉得自己已经不认识你了。

segments.en: I just can't build a relationship on a foundation of lies.
segments.zh: 我没法在谎言的基础上维系一段感情。

segments.en: I do love you but I can't go with you.
segments.zh: 我爱你，但我不能和你一起去。

segments.en: I'm sorry.
segments.zh: 对不起。

segments.en: I love you.
segments.zh: 我爱你。

segments.en: This is the last call for flight A15 from Los Angeles to Hyderabad.
segments.zh: 飞往海得拉巴的A15航班正在最后一次登机广播。

segments.en: I'm sorry, sir.
segments.zh: 对不起，先生。

segments.en: We can't wait any longer.
segments.zh: 我们不能再等了。

segments.en: You must board the plane.
segments.zh: 您必须登机了。

segments.en: Are you waiting for someone?
segments.zh: 你在等一个人吗？

segments.en: I was but I don't think she's coming.
segments.zh: 原本在等，但我想她不会来了。

segments.en: So Marco, I think I see a bit of a tear there in the corner of your eye.
segments.zh: 所以马可，我想我在你的眼角看到了一点泪水。

segments.en: I'm very sad.
segments.zh: 我很伤心。

segments.en: I can't believe he proposed and she just said no.
segments.zh: 我不敢相信他求婚，她就那么直接拒绝了。

segments.en: Just like that.
segments.zh: 就这样。

segments.en: Well, it's not supposed to happen.
segments.zh: 好吧，这不应该发生。

segments.en: Plus, he was inviting her to India and exotic getaway and promising.
segments.zh: 另外，他邀请她去印度，去异国度假，还许下承诺。

segments.en: Exotic getaway for the rest of her life.
segments.zh: 余生都能在异国度假。

segments.en: Well, what do you think will happen?
segments.zh: 嗯，你认为会发生什么？

segments.en: Part 10, it all ends.
segments.zh: 第 10 部分，一切都结束了。

segments.en: So do you think they all just keep on living their separate lives?
segments.zh: 那么你认为他们都只是继续过着各自的生活吗？

segments.en: Will they meet again?
segments.zh: 他们会再见面吗？

segments.en: Who knows?
segments.zh: 谁知道呢？

segments.en: Come to our website and tell us what you think will happen.
segments.zh: 访问我们的网站，告诉我们您认为会发生什么。

segments.en: So you can find us at EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 因此，您可以在 Englishpod.com 找到我们。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Don't miss our finale of this lesson and until next time, we'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 不要错过我们本课的结局，直到下一次，我们会在那里见到你们。
